Drawshot

Drawshot is a free paint shooter that runs in your browser. Walk and jump through a hand-drawn map, shoot the guards with your two paint guns and cover every surface in green paint.

How to play

  • Guards come after you. Every guard you defeat leaves a paint stain, and a surface turns green when all of its parts are stained.
  • Paint the ground and every platform green to complete the level.
  • Red guards stand on the small platforms and shoot back, so keep moving.

Coins, cards and your account

  • Every guard you defeat gives you a coin. Spend coins in the shop on upgrade cards, which change every 5 minutes.
  • Equip up to 3 cards at a time on the cards screen.
  • Log in with a username and a password (no e-mail address needed) to keep your coins and cards on every device.

Controls

Arrow keys to walk and jump, 1 and 2 to fire the left and right gun. On a phone or tablet, use the buttons under the game.
